info.title: ApiToolKit - Campaign Manager 360 API
info.description: ASP.NET Core Clean Architecture integration for Campaign Manager 360 API v5 (dfareporting): every resource - user profiles, accounts, advertisers, campaigns, placements, sites, ads, creatives, floodlight, conversions, targeting, reports and report files. Connect a Google account with GET /api/campaignmanager/auth/url?accountKey=..., then pass the same accountKey to every endpoint.
